name: Example trips give 64 days used and 26 left

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 (pins today to 2026-10-19 and clears saved trips in storage key ninety.trips.v1)
Scroll to the trip list and click 'Try an example' (data-testid=trip-example)
The trip list (data-testid=trip-list) shows exactly 3 trip rows (data-testid=trip-row)
The status panel (data-testid=status-panel) shows 64 days used out of 90
The status panel shows 26 days left
